items.title: closure state and deprecation truth should be durable rather than ambient

source_packets.pressure: record closed questions, deprecations, and failed ideas explicitly rather than letting them disappear
keep latest decision, no-publication posture, and queue status as explicit durable surfaces rather than inference from chronology
keep a small durable decision surface with explicit rationale and status so later sessions do not have to reconstruct closure from scattered doctrine
treat lineage edges and citation-head warnings as explicit public transitions rather than remembered source folklore

items.local_gap: DelayBasin could say what was live through open questions, assumptions, and followthrough, but it still lacked one compact durable packet for what had stopped being live, why, what replaced it, and what would reopen it.
items.bounded_take: Preserve an exact resolution witness plus tiny durable closure ledger naming the closed object, prior state, closure reason, successor or explicit absence, reopen trigger, state, and repair route.
explicit_non_take: a full public resolution court or supersession algebra
global decision-state coordination across every archive surface
long retrospective decision essays instead of compact closure packets

items.title: cooled candidate state should be durable rather than prose-only

source_packets.pressure: keep candidate, hold, and ready states durable so no-release or not-yet-ready decisions stay inspectable rather than ambient
make candidate / hold / published-ready / published queue states explicit schema-level objects rather than prose mood
keep blocking or outdated review state durable instead of letting half-reviewed work inherit current authority
preserve what feedback was integrated and what minimum publishable evidence is still pending rather than letting after-action narrative stand in for adjudication state

items.local_gap: DelayBasin already named retrospective writes in canon but still lacked a first-class durable queue and receipt witness for cooled candidates that remain captured-but-not-admitted across revisions.
items.bounded_take: Operationalize the existing retrospective-write law with one tiny RETROSPECTIVE-QUEUE surface and one receipt-level retrospective_write_witness for cooled candidates.
explicit_non_take: a full workflow engine or review court
promoting the stronger public sleep-phase / off-path consolidation story into canon now
expanding cooled admission into every archive surface regardless of need

items.title: public extracts should be durable while richer traces stay explicitly withheld

source_packets.pressure: keep richer operational or privileged traces role-scoped and reviewable rather than letting them quietly become the ordinary public surface
publish from a small stable public surface instead of the whole working archive and keep that public surface machine-readable
separate moving source trees from slower frozen public or release-queue surfaces so working residue does not silently inherit publication status
tie support claims to concise proof records and traceability scaffolding rather than broad workflow memory or diffuse drafting residue

items.local_gap: DelayBasin already had reasoning-firebreak canon and promptcraft, but it still lacked one durable witness saying what public extract the shipped revision actually counts on and what richer trace surface was intentionally not promoted.
items.bounded_take: Operationalize existing reasoning-firebreak law with one tiny FIREBREAK-LEDGER surface and one receipt-level reasoning_firebreak_witness.
explicit_non_take: a full private-log retention policy or role-based access system
a broader public trace-role controller or scratchpad state machine
treating local drafting residue as a durable archive surface
